evidence_quotes: depósito de resíduos sólidos inertes em área de proteção aos mananciais.
contaminar o lençol freático da represa Billings.
rationale: This TJSP decision addresses a municipality's appeal to continue depositing inert solid waste in a watershed protection zone (área de proteção aos mananciais) and directly adjudicates water-resource pollution risk—specifically whether leachate ("chorume") could contaminate the groundwater table (lençol freático) of the Billings reservoir. Because it directly adjudicates potential groundwater and reservoir pollution in addition to mananciais protection, both mananciais_calibrated_label and strict_service_access_label are WATER, under environmental_protection, with no household connection refusal or informal settlement access issue.
